rationale: Price sits below both session VWAP and 9-EMA after a 5.7-point intraday range on 3.86× relative volume, confirming seller control for most of the day. The last five 1-minute candles nevertheless display tightening around 59.40-59.50 with noticeably higher volume on the two up-closes versus the low-volume pullback candles, while the bid-ask spread has blown out to 102 bps. With only 66 minutes left and no news catalyst, neither long participation above the EMA nor short participation below the developing 1-minute shelf carries a clean enough edge to justify entry.
